scope: Internal AI-assisted checklist review of the uncirculated draft; no new mathematical result or external validation.

items.finding: The abstract already identifies the implication of a known lemma. The closing scope statement now says this once, without a catalogue of unrelated claims.
The proposition displays its degree bound directly. Field, positive n and k, total degree and multiplicity hypotheses remain consistent with the question and proof.
The proof never uses k >= 2^(n-2); the conclusion explicitly drops this restriction without claiming invention of the standard estimate.
Consolidated repeated novelty/method caveats into one concise contribution statement. The exact question remains explicitly identified.

items.item: Verify both ends of the connection.
items.finding: Recompared the journal Question 4.3 with published DKSS Definition 2.2 and Lemma 2.7, including the nonzero-polynomial hypothesis and unrestricted degree.
Shortened the version explanation to journal numbering versus arXiv-v1 Question 5.2. Both external numbers were checked against their respective PDFs.
All four authors of the question and all four authors of the lemma are credited; the note presents a direct implication, not a missing standard estimate.
Compared author names, accents, publication details and DOI identifiers with the primary papers; retained the explicit arXiv v1 reference and date.

items.item: Avoid unsupported priority or intent claims.
items.finding: The paper makes no priority claim and does not speculate about author intention. Prior acknowledgement and intended scope remain outstanding clarification items.
Retained the concise abstract: exact binary question, named existing lemma, and the removed threshold. No process history or proof-system jargon added.

items.item: Explain the idea in one short passage.
items.finding: Added a short opening explanation: add the required multiplicities and compare with degree times half the binary grid size.

items.item: Define exactly what the reader needs.
items.finding: Made the field and positive dimension explicit before introducing translated polynomials. Retained only the multiplicity and degree definitions needed here.
The proof explicitly uses the origin condition to exclude zero; the post-proof paragraph explains that this is its only role.
Kept the entire multiplicity inequality chain and integer-rounding calculation together in the proof.
Shortened version commentary and repeated caveats. Added no overview section, example, parameter table, appendix or new generalization.
The translated-polynomial definition matches Hasse derivatives in positive characteristic; zero has infinite multiplicity. Ordinary derivatives are not substituted.

items.item: Apply the lemma with all hypotheses satisfied.
items.finding: P is nonzero, n >= 1 and S = F2 is finite and nonempty. The imported total-degree bound has no degree/field-size condition.
There are 2^n-1 nonzero points; multiplicities are nonnegative; division by 2^(n-1) is valid and preserves the inequality.

Checked analytically: ceil(m-x)=m-floor(x) for integral m=2k. For n=1 the bound is k; for k=1 it is 1 when n=1 and 2 when n>=2. Integral quotients cause no exception. No sharpness outside the original range is claimed.
Every step concerns the original formal polynomial; no field-equation reduction occurs. The warning about losing multiplicity remains beside the definition.
Checked n,k,d,S, the fields, multi-index weight and origin notation. Internal references use labels; external numbers are version-qualified.
Made the author’s directing role and substantial AI role explicit, and stated the absence of independent mathematical review and formal verification. No human proof check is claimed.
Kept development details in DEVELOPMENT_HISTORY.md; the PDF contains only a concise disclosure and repository link.

items.item: Keep revision and review status consistent.
items.finding: Corrected the premature revision-1 label to version 1 in the paper and current publication documents. The author has not circulated it; these are in-place edits, not a version increment.

items.item: Check the final PDF after source edits.
items.finding: Rebuilt only after all source edits. Final PDF has two pages, version 1 on the title page, no warnings, embedded fonts and resolved references. Extracted content, external PDF links, page bounds and rendered raster margins passed fresh checks; this is automated layout QA, not independent human visual review. Source/PDF hashes refreshed.
Recorded each disposition below. Formalization and long-paper apparatus remain not applicable; human-author approval, independent review and possible author clarification remain outstanding.
